paragraphs: I am Mia, and I love animals. Today I have a new animal sound book. It is a gift from Dad. The book has three colorful pages and three buttons. Lily comes to my house to see it. My white kitten, Snow, sits on the table. "Push the button on each page," I say. "Then you hear the animal sound." I describe the pictures to Lily.

On page one, there is a big lion. It has gold eyes and a thick blond mane. The lion is tall, and its body is light brown. I push the button. "Roar!" says the book. The roar is very loud. Snow jumps off the table. "Does a lion really roar like this?" asks Lily. "Yes, it does," I say. We laugh, and we catch Snow. Then we sit down and look at the lion again.

On page two, there are two small fish. The fish are my favorite part of the book. One fish is gold, and the other is silver. They swim in a round blue pond. Their tails are long and thin. "I like the silver fish," says Lily. "I like the gold fish," I say. The button makes a soft water sound.

On page three, there is a tall brown bird. It is a dodo, and it has small wings. "This bird is extinct," I say. "It disappeared a long time ago." Lily looks sad, but I smile. "Do you know this bird?" asks Lily. "A little," I say. "It lived on an island." "We can read about it and learn," I say. I push the last button, and we hear a deep sound.
text.summary: Mia has a new animal sound book. She describes the color and size of a lion, two fish, and an extinct bird, and she shows Lily how to push the sound buttons.
